settings.question: Is your jewellery real 925 silver?
settings.answer: Yes. Every piece is 925 sterling silver and BIS hallmarked. You will find the 925 stamp on the piece.

settings.question: Will the plating fade or turn black?
settings.answer: Our plating is thick and sealed, so it lasts with everyday wear. Silver can naturally darken over time — a quick wipe with the polishing cloth brings it back. Plating is covered by our lifetime re-plating warranty.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Yes, COD is available on most pincodes across India. Enter your pincode on any product page to check delivery and COD for your area.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours and usually reach you in 3–6 working days. Metro cities are often faster.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Easy 15-day returns and exchanges on unused pieces in original packaging. Engraved pieces are personalised and cannot be returned.

settings.question: How do I find my ring size?
settings.answer: Open the Size guide on any ring page. Wrap a paper strip around your finger, measure it in mm and match it to the chart. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one.
